name: item
useFor: Use for list rows that open something. An email: ItemHeader (sender, date) over ItemContent (ItemTitle subject, ItemDescription preview). A webhook event: ItemHeader (a sm Badge and an arrow) over the event name and its count. A rail row: size sm with ItemMedia variant="icon" and a filled glyph. Mark the open one with aria-current="true". Separate rows with ItemSeparator.
constraints: Gray descriptions in email and event lists (they are purple)
A card border around every row in a list
source: Figma 427:2715: Agent Workspace - Inbox (email list), Webhooks - Event catalog (event list), the rail
title: Item
description: A row of content: an email in the inbox, a webhook event, or a rail row, washing lilac when hovered or selected.
